events.content:
Typecheck passes. Created `middleware.ts:1` at the project root.

How it works:
- Generates a unique ID via `crypto.randomUUID()` (available in the Edge runtime that middleware runs in).
- Logs `request.nextUrl.pathname` to the console.
- Sets `X-Request-Id` on the response via `NextResponse.next()` so the header reaches all matched responses.
- The `matcher` applies the middleware to all routes except Next.js static assets (`_next/static`, `_next/image`, `favicon.ico`), which is the idiomatic Next.js pattern.

part.text:
Typecheck passes. Created `middleware.ts:1` at the project root.

How it works:
- Generates a unique ID via `crypto.randomUUID()` (available in the Edge runtime that middleware runs in).
- Logs `request.nextUrl.pathname` to the console.
- Sets `X-Request-Id` on the response via `NextResponse.next()` so the header reaches all matched responses.
- The `matcher` applies the middleware to all routes except Next.js static assets (`_next/static`, `_next/image`, `favicon.ico`), which is the idiomatic Next.js pattern.
